plan.path_summary: Estimate a Gamma generalized linear model with log link for the positive Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter, using the SMD-versus-PR contrast. Task2 additionally enforces the instructed 1945-2003 period.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Task1: observations with smd coded smd or pr and nonmissing positive pldist1. Task2: years 1945-2003 inclusive, smd coded smd or pr, and nonmissing positive pldist1.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for variables required by each task; Gamma model also requires positive pldist1.
path_signature.variable_construction: Clean smd labels to lower-case smd/pr; create smd_bin=1 for smd and 0 for pr; use pldist1 unaggregated as the positive Manifesto-method distance outcome.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative for the SMD coefficient in the log mean distance model, equivalently a SMD-vs-PR mean distance ratio below 1. Support requires expected direction with p <= 0.05, or borderline support for 0.05 < p <= 0.055 when the estimate is substantively meaningful and the interval narrowly crosses the null. Clearly weak aligned evidence is inconclusive. Opposite requires a positive coefficient with affirmative p < 0.05 evidence and an interval above zero.

analysis_path.path_description: Use all authorized observations with smd/pr election-rule coding and estimate whether SMD elections have a lower expected Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter than PR elections using a Gamma GLM with log link.
preprocessing_steps: Verify that pldist1 and smd exist.
Clean smd to lower-case labels and keep only smd or pr.
Drop rows missing pldist1 or cleaned smd.
Keep positive pldist1 values because the Gamma GLM requires positive outcomes.
Create smd_bin equal to 1 for smd and 0 for pr.
Estimate GLM with Gamma family and log link: pldist1 ~ smd_bin, using HC1 robust covariance.
Report coefficient, robust standard error, p-value, 95% confidence interval, exponentiated mean distance ratio, group summaries, sample flow, and conclusion class.

key_choices.outcome_measure: pldist1, Manifesto-method distance of the plurality vote winner from the median voter.
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: smd_bin, binary contrast equal to 1 for SMD and 0 for PR.
key_choices.sample_restriction: Authorized rows with smd coded smd or pr and positive nonmissing pldist1.
key_choices.outlier_rule: No outlier removal; all positive pldist1 values are retained.
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1 and smd_clean; positive pldist1 is required by the Gamma family.
key_choices.data_processing: Clean categorical smd labels, create binary SMD indicator, no aggregation, no outcome winsorization, no country or time fixed effects.
key_choices.model_choice: Gamma GLM with log link and HC1 robust covariance.
key_choices.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative for smd_bin. Support requires expected direction with p <= 0.05, or borderline support for 0.05 < p <= 0.055 when the estimate is substantively meaningful and the interval narrowly crosses the null; clearly weak aligned evidence is inconclusive; opposite requires affirmative evidence of a material positive coefficient.

models.type: Gamma generalized linear model with log link
models.planned_estimation: Coefficient on smd_bin on the log expected distance scale and exp(coefficient) as SMD-vs-PR expected distance ratio.
models.inference_criteria: A negative smd_bin coefficient or ratio below 1 is claim-aligned. Support requires p <= 0.05, or 0.05 < p <= 0.055 only as borderline support when the estimate is meaningful and the confidence interval narrowly crosses the null. A positive coefficient is opposite only if p < 0.05 and the confidence interval excludes zero above the null.
models.qualification: The anchor uses a linear comparison of distance, but the inspected pldist1 distribution is strictly positive and right-skewed. A Gamma GLM with log link is a defensible robustness model for positive continuous distances while preserving the same outcome source, focal contrast, sample, and conclusion rule.

outcome.name: pldist1
outcome.definition: Manifesto-method ideological distance between the plurality vote winner and the median voter; smaller values mean closer to the median voter.
outcome.variable_construction: Used in its original positive units as the GLM outcome; no scaling, aggregation, winsorization, or categorization.
outcome.missing_data_handling: Drop rows with missing pldist1; require pldist1 > 0 for the Gamma model.
outcome.qualification: The focal claim is directly about the plurality vote winner being close to the median voter, which pldist1 operationalizes.

main_predictor.definition: Binary election-rule contrast: 1 for single-member district systems, 0 for proportional representation systems.
main_predictor.variable_construction: Constructed from smd after lower-case cleaning and retaining smd/pr labels.
main_predictor.missing_data_handling: Drop rows with missing or non-smd/pr smd values.
main_predictor.qualification: The focal claim is explicitly about SMD election rules; PR observations provide the comparison category used in the paper's electoral-system comparisons.

method_justification.claim_alignment: The path tests whether plurality winners are closer to the median voter under SMD by comparing the Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance pldist1 between SMD and PR election-rule observations. Smaller distance is the operational meaning of being close to the median voter.
method_justification.dataset_alignment: Both tasks use only the authorized original file data/powell_original.dta. Task2 uses the instructed 1945-2003 period and Manifesto-method variable pldist1.
method_justification.method_reason: A Gamma GLM with log link is suitable for the inspected positive continuous distance outcome, which is right-skewed. It preserves the focal variable structure and yields an interpretable SMD-vs-PR expected distance ratio without arbitrary categorization or outlier removal.
method_justification.novelty_reason: Shared Memory already contains OLS with decade fixed effects, simple OLS, and median quantile regression paths for these tasks. This path changes only the model family to a Gamma log-link GLM while preserving the outcome, contrast, data source, Task2 period, and conclusion rule.
